name: app-realtor-app-long-case-study-with-logo-grid-and-icon-packs
title: Realtor App Long Case Study with Logo Grid
whatItIs: A very tall white case study with a phone on chrome steps, an About section, a dark concrete room with an overlay message, a logo and icons section with a construction grid for a teal and orange flame mark, bold and light icon packs and app icon mockups.
whatItMeans: Showing the mark on its construction grid and as an icon makes the identity feel rigorous, and dark chrome scenes add drama to a light page.
techniques: Logo shown on a construction grid
Bold and light icon packs side by side
Dark concrete room image as a full-width break
Chrome step props for the hero phone
App icon shown beside system icons

vocabulary.definition: A set of icons in one style, such as bold or light.
Guides showing the geometry of a logo.
A wide image separating text sections.
